Worked on the build and modification of site to site VPN tunnels with the third party vendors on Cisco ASAs

Troubleshooting connectivity issues and various issues related to network devices. ◦ Palo Alto Cloud VPNs : Worked on setting up multiple site to site VPNs on the palo alto firewalls for vendors or third parties using AWS/Azure/GCP cloud infrastructure.

Worked on managing virtual servers, services, and service groups, setting up health checks and persistence policies.

Network Engineer

May 2021 – June 2022

Worked on F5 LTM load balancer and its various tasks include F5 service integrations such as addition and removal of Nodes to VIPs, creation of VIPs to accomplish server load balancing.

Configuration of various VIP parameters, building out new client specific F5s, updating SSL standard certs and Client certificates on the F5s.

Worked on the build and modification of site to site VPN tunnels with the third party vendors on Cisco ASAs

Troubleshooting connectivity issues and various issues related to network devices. ◦ In addition to the service delivery tasks such as configuring ACLs, NATs, routes, Virtual servers and VPN configurations, took ownership of various projects and go live initiatives that helped hone my collaborative and leadership attributes.

Worked in a project that involved firewall migrations from Cisco ASAs to Palos implemented where NAT, routing, ACL policies and interface configuration had to be built out.

Helped in configuring SNMP and multiple network devices throughout the infrastructure in collaboration with the monitoring teams.

Configured basic routing protocols (OSPF, EIGRP, BGP) on our agg and CPE routers. ◦ Provided 12x7 weekday and weekend oncall support

Worked with the dev teams in configuring a NAT automation self service tool for all NAT clients that will automatically login to the tool and perform the necessary configuration based on input using VRA tool. ◦ As a SME , mentored the team members on various technical concepts and troubleshooting.

Wipro

Mysuru ,India

Network Engineer

Oct 2019 – April 2021 ◦ As an Network Engineer in Wipro, I initiated my journey right from the networking basics and then

hands-on experience with enterprise-grade Cisco infrastructure .

Worked on performing NAT configurations on routers and firewalls Cisco routers and ASA firewalls. ◦ Supported enterprise networks across branch offices, data centers, and disaster recovery sites.

Monitored network performance and health using HPNNMI, IMC, and Sapphire monitoring tools.

Troubleshot routing, switching, and connectivity issues ensuring minimal business impact.

Resolved escalated incidents and collaborated with technical teams to restore services quickly.

Prepared network reports and supported operational maintenance and network ◦ upgrade activities.

Vinayaka R- Page 2 of 4

Certifications

CCNA - Cisco Certified Network Associate

OCI Foundations Associate

Technical Skills

Routing & Switching: BGP,MPLS, OSPF, EIGRP, VLAN, STP, ARP Cisco IOS XR, Cisco ACI,L2,L3 Basics of: SDWAN, DHCP, DNS

Network Security: NAT, IPsec VPN, Firewall: CISCO ASA 55XX, 5585x (Version 8.x & 9.x). Palo Alto (PAN-OS 8.1), (Panorama – OS 9.1), F5 Big IP, Netscaler,IPS/IDS, ACLs, NATs, VPN

Cloud: OCI, AWS, Terraform deployments

Monitoring/Troubleshooting: SNMP, Zabbix, Wireshark

Documentation and Processes: Incident and Change Management, Jira, Conflueence.

Major Projects:

Project: Cisco ASA to Palo Alto NGFW Migration

Overview: This project involved migrating the organization’s network security infrastructure from Cisco ASA firewalls to Palo Alto Networks Next-Generation Firewalls (NGFWs). The objective was to enhance network security, improve application visibility, strengthen threat prevention capabilities, and simplify firewall management while ensuring minimal downtime during the migration.

Key Responsibilities:

Analyzed and reviewed the existing Cisco ASA firewall configuration, including access control lists (ACLs), NAT policies, VPN configurations, and security rules.

Planned and executed the migration strategy by translating Cisco ASA policies into Palo Alto security policies using best practices.

Configured security zones, interfaces, virtual routers, NAT rules, security policies, and service objects on Palo Alto firewalls.

Migrated site-to-site and remote access VPN configurations while validating secure connectivity. • Performed policy optimization by consolidating redundant rules and implementing application-based security using App-ID.

Enabled advanced security features such as Threat Prevention, URL Filtering, Anti-Virus, Anti-Spyware, and WildFire integration.

Conducted pre-migration validation, post-migration testing, and troubleshooting to ensure seamless connectivity and application availability.

Worked closely with network, security, and application teams during implementation and change windows to minimize business impact.

Monitored firewall performance and security logs using Palo Alto monitoring tools and generated reports for validation and compliance.

Documented migration procedures, firewall configurations, rollback plans, and operational handover documentation.

Vinayaka R- Page 3 of 4

Project: Enterprise Network Migration to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) and Amazon Web Services (AWS)

Overview: This project focused on migrating enterprise network infrastructure from traditional on-premises data centers to cloud environments hosted on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) and Amazon Web Services (AWS). The primary objective was to improve scalability, availability, security, and operational efficiency while enabling a hybrid and cloud-first architecture.

Key Responsibilities:

Assessed the existing on-premises network architecture and developed a cloud migration strategy. • Designed and configured Virtual Cloud Networks (VCNs) in OCI and Virtual Private Clouds (VPCs) in AWS. • Configured subnets, route tables, Internet Gateways, NAT Gateways, Service Gateways, Security Lists, Network Security Groups (NSGs), and Security Groups.

Established secure connectivity between on-premises data centers and cloud environments using IPSec VPNs and dedicated connectivity (FastConnect for OCI and Direct Connect for AWS, where applicable). • Implemented network segmentation, access control policies, and firewall security to protect cloud resources. • Migrated applications and workloads while ensuring minimal downtime and maintaining business continuity. • Configured load balancers, DNS services, and high-availability architectures to improve application performance

and resilience.

Performed network validation, connectivity testing, troubleshooting, and performance optimization after migration. • Collaborated with cloud, network, security, and application teams throughout planning, implementation, and post- migration support.

Prepared migration documentation, network diagrams, rollback procedures, and operational handover documents.

Soft Skills

Communication • Problem Solving • Stakeholder Coordination • Team Collaboration • Adaptability • Time Management

Vinayaka R- Page 4 of 4

sections.text:
Technical Skills
Routing & Switching: BGP,MPLS, OSPF, EIGRP, VLAN, STP, ARP Cisco IOS XR, Cisco ACI,L2,L3 Basics of: SDWAN, DHCP, DNS
Network Security: NAT, IPsec VPN, Firewall: CISCO ASA 55XX, 5585x (Version 8.x & 9.x). Palo Alto (PAN-OS 8.1), (Panorama – OS 9.1), F5 Big IP, Netscaler,IPS/IDS, ACLs, NATs, VPN
Cloud: OCI, AWS, Terraform deployments
Monitoring/Troubleshooting: SNMP, Zabbix, Wireshark
Documentation and Processes: Incident and Change Management, Jira, Conflueence.
Major Projects:
Project: Cisco ASA to Palo Alto NGFW Migration
Overview: This project involved migrating the organization’s network security infrastructure from Cisco ASA firewalls to Palo Alto Networks Next-Generation Firewalls (NGFWs). The objective was to enhance network security, improve application visibility, strengthen threat prevention capabilities, and simplify firewall management while ensuring minimal downtime during the migration.
Key Responsibilities:
Analyzed and reviewed the existing Cisco ASA firewall configuration, including access control lists (ACLs), NAT policies, VPN configurations, and security rules.
Planned and executed the migration strategy by translating Cisco ASA policies into Palo Alto security policies using best practices.
Configured security zones, interfaces, virtual routers, NAT rules, security policies, and service objects on Palo Alto firewalls.
Migrated site-to-site and remote access VPN configurations while validating secure connectivity. • Performed policy optimization by consolidating redundant rules and implementing application-based security using App-ID.
Enabled advanced security features such as Threat Prevention, URL Filtering, Anti-Virus, Anti-Spyware, and WildFire integration.
Conducted pre-migration validation, post-migration testing, and troubleshooting to ensure seamless connectivity and application availability.
Worked closely with network, security, and application teams during implementation and change windows to minimize business impact.
Monitored firewall performance and security logs using Palo Alto monitoring tools and generated reports for validation and compliance.
Documented migration procedures, firewall configurations, rollback plans, and operational handover documentation.
Vinayaka R- Page 3 of 4
Project: Enterprise Network Migration to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) and Amazon Web Services (AWS)
Overview: This project focused on migrating enterprise network infrastructure from traditional on-premises data centers to cloud environments hosted on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) and Amazon Web Services (AWS). The primary objective was to improve scalability, availability, security, and operational efficiency while enabling a hybrid and cloud-first architecture.
Key Responsibilities:
Assessed the existing on-premises network architecture and developed a cloud migration strategy. • Designed and configured Virtual Cloud Networks (VCNs) in OCI and Virtual Private Clouds (VPCs) in AWS. • Configured subnets, route tables, Internet Gateways, NAT Gateways, Service Gateways, Security Lists, Network Security Groups (NSGs), and Security Groups.
Established secure connectivity between on-premises data centers and cloud environments using IPSec VPNs and dedicated connectivity (FastConnect for OCI and Direct Connect for AWS, where applicable). • Implemented network segmentation, access control policies, and firewall security to protect cloud resources. • Migrated applications and workloads while ensuring minimal downtime and maintaining business continuity. • Configured load balancers, DNS services, and high-availability architectures to improve application performance
and resilience.
Performed network validation, connectivity testing, troubleshooting, and performance optimization after migration. • Collaborated with cloud, network, security, and application teams throughout planning, implementation, and post- migration support.
Prepared migration documentation, network diagrams, rollback procedures, and operational handover documents.
Soft Skills
Communication • Problem Solving • Stakeholder Coordination • Team Collaboration • Adaptability • Time Management
